name: Pocket Animation Studio
description: Rebuild a short moving geometric scene with a visual drawing-block program.
natural_language: Use only screenshots and visible controls in this task webpage. Rebuild the four-layer moving scene: drag shape and expression blocks into the program, edit every visible number, run the complete preview, and certify the match. Solve only from the visible task UI. Do not use code, scripts, automation, Developer Tools, console, debugger, inspector, network, source, DOM, or page-state inspection; do not use a terminal, shell, Python, address bar, URL or query edits, reload or navigation, browser extensions, external applications, hidden state, or unrelated tabs.

metadata.notes: Original bridge from Blockly Movie: the visible reference is a time-varying sequence of circles, rectangles, and lines; the agent edits a visual program and is graded on the rendered trajectory at intermediate times, not on a single frame or a private formula string.
